sources.snippet: LLM/VLM-backed prompt writers for the open-weight MiniMax H3 video model — a local stand-in for the closed H3-Context-IR module. You write casual intent; the node writes the structured prompt H3-Base actually expects and feeds it to the native MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo / MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo nodes.
